q.g: The locked section of the ZB-014 bunker on Woods mentioned by Prapor does not have a guaranteed chance for the wanted magazines, but they can be found there quite often. A ZB-014 key is required to enter it. They can also be obtained from weapon boxes, green wooden crates or bosses and their guards, for example Sanitar.

sh.c: Magazines on the barrels and on the ground
